children: Midnight plans to introduce mainnet support for Solana wallets with its ledger v9 upgrade by December 31, 2026. The planned integration would enable private swaps and private DeFi directly from Solana wallets, bringing access to Midnight's privacy features into wallets that Solana users already use.

Access without a separate installation would expand Midnight's distribution to Solana wallet holders and reduce the steps needed to use its private DeFi services. That wider access could increase demand for NIGHT if users adopt those services. Support is currently live only on testnet, so mainnet delivery and adoption remain unproven.
Mainnet release is planned with the Midnight ledger v9 upgrade later this year

title: Solana: Midnight plans mainnet wallet support with ledger v9 - By 31 Dec 2026
